sources.finding: Native cross-attention queries norm3 of post-self-attention state; 3072-dimensional Q/K/V/O and 24 heads of width 128 for this checkpoint.
Text and image attention share Q; new image-side K/V are initialized from text projections and trained separately. Sharing Q is not evidence for bypassing modality adaptation.
BasicTransformerBlock order is self attention residual, grounding fuser, text cross attention residual, FFN residual.
Joint text/video attention uses modality-specific adaptive normalization because semantics and numerical scales differ.

Diffusion timestep conditioning can generate high-dimensional modulation; scalar conditioning is not intrinsically invalid, but this does not establish usefulness of the local intensity-to-query rank-one bias.

Physical condition tokens are concatenated with point tokens and normalized separately. This is a simulation-trained point-trajectory model, not direct evidence for swapping the pretrained Wan query source.
Video-state queries attend to local physical text keys/values; temporal chunk RoPE alignment is explicit. Our C has no equivalent grounded chunk index.

Video-state queries attend to physical-state K/V in dual cross-attention. Uses a separate evolving physical branch and V-JEPA2, unlike the current project constraints; supports relevance of latent physical conditioning but not a novelty claim for the broad idea.
Learned queries compress retrieved VideoMAE physical features before DiT fusion. Extraction queries are distinct from the video-state queries being discussed here.
